name: Trolls of a Feather
label: Quest
description: Trolls of a Feather: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My pet is almost done. Now I just need something to stuff it with.
Only the voodoo feathers from the trolls in the sunken temple will do. They go by the names Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. Kill them. Kill them all.
This is no trivial task friend, so I'll make it worth your while by giving you something of Niby's -- he probably doesn't need it anyhow.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you bring the feathers? This doll needs stuffed!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wonderful, now my pet is complete!
Oh, what an odd side effect these voodoo feathers have...
